intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按“第三次考驾照 -> 拥挤交通中成功 -> 开出城后有信心 -> 假设突发危险 -> 敲窗后必须停车 -> 听见但反应太慢 -> 猛踩刹车”的故事线跟读。重点读清 being tested, for the third time, had been asked, acquire confidence, Let us suppose, As soon as, within five feet, react 和 brake pedal。

sentences.text: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我第三次接受驾照考试。注意 was being tested 是正在被测试，for the third time 要读出“第三次”的压力。

sentences.text: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我被要求在拥挤交通中驾驶，并且顺利完成了。had been asked 是完成时被动，heavy traffic 和 successfully 形成“先成功”的铺垫。

sentences.text: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：被指示开出城后，我开始有了信心。After having been instructed 是长开头，began to acquire confidence 要读出信心逐渐上来。

sentences.text: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing, Mr. Eames.'
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：考官想必对我的表现很满意，因为他笑着说：只剩一项了。must have been 是对过去的强推断，performance 读清第二音节。

sentences.text: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：让我们假设一个孩子突然在你面前穿过马路。Let us suppose 用来设置假设情境，这里是模拟测试，不是真实事故。

sentences.text: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我一敲车窗，你就必须在五英尺内停下。As soon as 是一...就...，within five feet 是测试的短距离条件。

sentences.text: Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：虽然声音听得很清楚，但我花了很长时间才反应过来。Though 先让步，it took me a long time to react 是失败关键。

sentences.text: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal and we were both thrown forward.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我突然踩下刹车踏板，我们俩都向前冲去。pressed the brake pedal 是动作，were both thrown forward 是被动结果。
